source_inspections.assessment: Defines the invariant and supplies compact-set structural statements. Theorem 5 requires both sets compact; the slit-complement domain is noncompact, so the theorem does not imply equality of the slit Beer index or optimize a position. No exact slit probability or global ellipse optimizer is given.

value.rationale: A zero-measure barrier affects the nonconvexity probability without affecting sampling mass. The theorem identifies unique global position and direction extremizers for all ellipses, an explicit universal profile and a sharp half-visibility limit; it addresses a natural shape-optimization gap rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
